narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I take away the tops and take away the bottoms. The bottom becomes zero.
<bookmark mark='zero'/>A bottom number of zero would mean the bar is cut into no pieces at all.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Tanvi only gave pieces away, and every piece left is still one seventh of the bar.
<bookmark mark='keep'/>The bottom number names the unit, and the unit stays the same when we take away.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>When both fractions have the same unit, take away the top numbers and keep the unit.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn: what is left when you take two sixths away from five sixths?
